question: 在同一 Codex CLI、同一测试数据和同一确定性验收门禁下，结构化意图/Goal Prompt 是否减少 Core Builder 的返工？

design.control: control-legacy：仅传递场景、优先级和 must-have 能力，并保留共享安全规则、测试数据、验收契约和迭代规则。
design.treatment: treatment-current：传递 Intent、Goal、业务流程、预期结果、验收方式和数据集上下文，并保留同一组共享门禁。
design.order: control-legacy 全部运行后再运行 treatment-current；因此本报告是 pilot 信号，不是无偏因果估计。

paired_observations.control: 1 revision; first Chromium run failed and acceptance-child evidence was missing; final publish passed.
paired_observations.treatment: 1 revision; first Chromium run failed because the generated page did not reference the invoice fixture files; final publish passed.
paired_observations.classification: Core output was repairable; failure appeared at acceptance/release gate, not as terminal Builder failure.

paired_observations.control: 1 revision; first run had CLI timeout, missing acceptance-child evidence and Chromium failure; final publish passed.
paired_observations.treatment: 0 revisions; CLI timeout/fallback was recorded as an intermediate process event, then acceptance and fresh-browser audit passed.
paired_observations.classification: Control had a gate failure requiring Builder repair; treatment had an infrastructure/process event without final product failure.

paired_observations.control: 2 revisions; first Chromium assertion missed the required reason text, then one acceptance-child evidence issue; final publish passed.
paired_observations.treatment: 0 revisions; acceptance and fresh-browser audit passed on the first candidate.
paired_observations.classification: Control required two external gate-triggered repair rounds; treatment reached a passing candidate directly.

paired_observations.control: 1 revision; first run had CLI timeout, missing acceptance-child evidence and Chromium failure; final publish passed.
paired_observations.treatment: 0 revisions; acceptance and all three Chromium journeys passed on the first candidate.
paired_observations.classification: Control had a gate failure requiring repair; treatment had no terminal or release failure.

failure_boundary.intermediate_cli_or_acceptance_events: 存在；它们只有在导致验收/发布不通过时才形成返工次数。
failure_boundary.invalid_attempt: A-002 因 API 未重启加载新 schema，控制请求被旧服务默认成 treatment；已排除，不计入 A/B。

conclusion: 本 pilot 支持一个初步信号：结构化 Intent/Goal Prompt 让同一套 Core Builder 门禁下的返工显著减少，但没有证明最终发布率提升，因为两组均为 4/4。由于运行顺序未随机交错、样本只有 4 对，不能把 80% 返工下降写成稳定因果结论。正式结论需要在 20 个 case 上随机交错重复运行。
